basis.label: Reporting basis
basis.grossDescription: Recorded income and expenses before explicit refund and principal classification.
basis.netDescription: Explicit allocation roles in native currencies. No automatic refunds or mixed-currency total.

dialog.title: Classify consumption
dialog.description: Assign an explicit role to each allocation. Split rows are classified separately; refunds and principal require a purchase you choose.

fields.historicalAssignment: This historical version is no longer selectable. It remains unchanged until you explicitly choose and save another classification.
fields.confirmedPurchaseRequired: Requires an existing confirmed purchase reference.

roles.asset_acquisition: Asset acquisition (excluded from consumption; no holding created)

guidance.refund: Requires a confirmed same-currency purchase and reduces consumption in that purchase category at the refund date.
guidance.principal: Expense principal requires a confirmed same-currency purchase; it is not incoming loan recovery.
guidance.other_income: User-confirmed non-earned cash receipt; no gain or interest is inferred.
guidance.principal_recovery: Incoming untracked loan principal. It creates no receivable match or interest; use Receivables for tracked payments.
guidance.asset_acquisition: Excluded from consumption. It creates no holding or net-worth value; manage investments independently.

actions.reviewPeriod: Review all transactions in this period

errors.classificationRequired: Choose a classification explicitly before saving.
errors.purchaseRequired: Choose the purchase this refund or principal allocation references.
errors.clearDependents: Open the referenced refund or principal allocations and clear them before changing this purchase.

period.label: Net consumption period
period.invalid: Enter real calendar dates, with start on or before end.

report.title: Net consumption
report.complete: Classification and independent source coverage are complete for this period.
report.incomplete: This is not a complete zero or total. Resolve classifications and account coverage before relying on it.
report.mainComplete: All recognized allocations were converted at their transaction dates, and classification and source coverage are complete.
report.mainPartial: Partial known converted subtotals only. Missing rates, classifications, or source coverage prevent complete totals.
report.mainUnavailable: Main-currency totals are unavailable because no report currency is configured. Native evidence remains below.
report.nativeDescription: Original currencies are kept separate. These subtotals do not remove classification or source-coverage uncertainty.
report.noKnownTotals: No known classified subtotal for this period.
report.categoryNative: Native currencies; categories are not converted or combined.

bulk.title: Classify transactions
bulk.description: Choose allocations from the {{count}} transactions on the current visible page, then preview their exact effects.

candidates.title: Current-page allocations
candidates.scope: This session is limited to these {{count}} visible transactions. Changing filters does not add hidden results.
candidates.empty: There are no transactions on this visible page.

treatment.title: Treatments and references
treatment.setAll: Set one treatment for all selected allocations
treatment.chooseForAll: Choose a treatment to set for all

preview.title: Reviewed preview
preview.noChanges: No classifications would change. Nothing will be written.
preview.confirm: I reviewed every allocation, treatment, reference, native-currency effect, and validation message in this preview.

effects.title: Classification-only effect
effects.statement: This changes classification only. Balances, amounts, dates, categories, statuses, import and FX evidence, review and duplicate decisions, receivables, and holdings remain unchanged.

errors.selectionRequired: Select at least one explicit allocation.
errors.treatmentRequired: Choose a treatment for every selected allocation.
errors.purchaseRequired: Choose an existing confirmed purchase for every treatment that requires one.
